content.help: Master switch for 3D floating interaction prompts. On = anchor prompts directly onto doors, items, NPCs, and containers in world space. Off = restore fixed vanilla HUD prompts.
On = keep fixed vanilla visor prompt placement while wearing Power Armor. Off = continue floating prompts in 3D inside Power Armor.
On = keep prompts clamped inside Screen Edge Margin when an object sits near or outside the screen border. Off = let prompts follow objects off-screen.
How quickly the floating prompt catches up to target screen movement each frame. Increase (e.g. 0.70-1.00) for instant locked-on tracking; decrease (e.g. 0.15) for softer, slower gliding.
Minimum distance in pixels from screen borders when clamping is enabled. Increase (e.g. 100 px) to keep prompts closer to center; decrease (e.g. 20 px) to let them approach the edges.
On = hide active companion/follower prompts unless you stand within Max Companion Distance (vanilla lets companions intercept prompts up to ~180 units away). Off = keep vanilla range.
Maximum distance in game units for companion prompts outside combat (default 120; vanilla ~180). Increase to talk/trade from farther away; decrease (e.g. 80) to require standing right next to them.

Maximum distance for companion prompts during combat. Set to 0 to completely hide companion Talk/Trade prompts in fights (Revive/Stimpak always remains available); increase (e.g. 120) to allow combat commands.

content.text: Prevent Companion Loot Focus Steal (Requires Limit)
content.help: Requires Limit Companion Prompt Distance. Eliminates the wide companion pick radius so nearby followers cannot steal crosshair focus while you are looting containers or corpses.
On = when a companion prompt is hidden by distance or combat rules, block E (Talk) and R (Trade / Transfer) on them so R still reloads or draws/holsters your weapon normally.

content.text: Hold Time to Grab Objects / Corpses (sec)
content.help: Seconds E / Activate must be held before picking up and dragging physical objects or corpses (vanilla is ~0.30s). Increase (e.g. 1.50s) to avoid dragging corpses when fast-looting; decrease for faster pickup.
Minimum time in ms after looting a magazine, bobblehead, or legendary item before E/Enter can close its showcase popup. Increase (e.g. 800 ms) so rapid E taps do not skip the bonus; set 0 to disable.
Controls prompt visibility while aiming down sights: Off = always show; Hide NPC Prompts = hide distracting NPC prompts while aiming a weapon; Hide All = keep aiming completely clean.
On = hide close-range NPC prompts (Talk, Pickpocket, Trade) beyond Max NPC Close-Action Distance so distant NPCs do not display unreachable prompts. Off = keep vanilla NPC range.
Maximum distance in game units for close NPC actions like Talk or Pickpocket. Increase (e.g. 250) to see prompts earlier; decrease (e.g. 140) to match actual touch reach.
On = keep long-range perk/mod actions (Intimidate, Pacify, Incite, Overture) visible up to Ranged Max Distance while close actions like Pickpocket or Talk stay hidden beyond Close-Action Distance.

content.text: Ranged NPC Action Max Distance (0 = Unlimited)
content.help: Maximum distance in game units for ranged NPC actions such as Intimidate or Overture. Set to 0 for unlimited vanilla range; decrease (e.g. 450) to hide them on very distant NPCs.

content.text: Hide Prompts Blocked by Solid Walls
content.help: On = suppress floating prompts and QuickLoot when solid walls or terrain block line of sight from your eyes/camera to the target. Off = allow occluded targets to show prompts.
On = in 3rd person (when not aiming), detect nearby interactables directly in front of your character even if the camera crosshair is slightly off. Off = require direct crosshair aim.
Fallback Only (recommended) activates only when the crosshair has no target. Smart Hybrid also swaps to very close loose items at your feet when the crosshair is aimed far away (>155 units).
Maximum search radius around the player character in 3rd person. Increase (e.g. 170) to detect nearby items from farther away; decrease (e.g. 90) to catch only objects right in front of you.
Half-angle cone in front of your character/camera used to find nearby interactables. Increase (e.g. 75 deg) to catch items wider to the sides; decrease (e.g. 35 deg) to stay tightly centered ahead.

Minimum time in ms to stay locked onto the current assist target before switching to another nearby item. Increase (e.g. 400 ms) to stop prompt flickering on cluttered shelves; decrease (e.g. 100 ms) for faster switching.
On = allow 3rd-person proximity assist to pick up nearby loose items (weapons, ammo, aid, junk, magazines).
On = allow 3rd-person proximity assist to target nearby doors, buttons, switches, and named activators.
On = allow 3rd-person proximity assist to target nearby chairs, beds, workbenches, and terminals.
On = allow 3rd-person proximity assist to target containers and corpses (pressing E opens full Transfer/Loot since QuickLoot requires direct crosshair focus).
On = require holding the button instead of tapping for chosen risky or accidental actions, with a progress ring indicator in Modern style. Off = all actions trigger immediately on tap.
Seconds the action button must be held to trigger protected actions. Increase (e.g. 0.80s) for stronger protection against accidental clicks; decrease (e.g. 0.30s) for faster deliberate holds.
Visual style of the progress ring around held buttons: Monochrome (White) = crisp white ring with dark casing; Accent Color = uses your configured Accent / Selection Color.
Require holding E when drinking dirty water from sinks, pumps, puddles, or Activate water sources.
Require holding E before sitting in chairs/benches or sleeping in beds, preventing accidental animations mid-combat or mid-looting.
Require holding E/R before committing Steal, Steal From, or Pickpocket actions so you do not accidentally turn NPCs hostile.
Require holding to Eat world food directly or perform Cannibal / Corpse feeding actions.
Require holding when crafting at workbenches or entering/modifying Power Armor frames (works on both world prompts and QuickLoot workbench actions).
World-space East (+X) / West (-X) anchor shift for doors (0 = centered on handle/door). Use Modern Screen Offset X in Visual Style for 2D screen shifts.
World-space North (+Y) / South (-Y) anchor shift for doors (usually keep at 0).
Vertical world-space Z offset for doors. Increase (+Z) toward 0 to raise toward the center/handle; decrease (-Z, e.g. -20) to place it just below the door lock.
World-space East (+X) / West (-X) anchor shift for NPCs and companions (usually keep at 0).
World-space North (+Y) / South (-Y) anchor shift for NPCs and companions (usually keep at 0).
Vertical world-space Z offset relative to an NPC's torso/chest bone. Increase (e.g. +20) to float near the shoulder/head; decrease (e.g. -10) to sit lower on the chest.
World-space East (+X) / West (-X) anchor shift for containers (usually keep at 0).
World-space North (+Y) / South (-Y) anchor shift for containers (usually keep at 0).
Vertical world-space Z offset for container prompts. Increase (e.g. +20) to float higher above lids; decrease toward 0 to sit right on the container center.
World-space East (+X) / West (-X) anchor shift for loose items (usually keep at 0).
World-space North (+Y) / South (-Y) anchor shift for loose items (usually keep at 0).
Vertical world-space Z offset for loose items. Increase (+Z) to float higher above objects; decrease (-Z, e.g. -8) to hug small tabletop items tightly.
World-space East (+X) / West (-X) anchor shift for terminals, workbenches, and furniture (usually keep at 0).
World-space North (+Y) / South (-Y) anchor shift for terminals, workbenches, and furniture (usually keep at 0).
Vertical world-space Z offset for terminals, workbenches, chairs, and beds. Increase (e.g. +15) to raise above the station; decrease to lower onto the seat/screen.

Vanilla moves Fallout 4's native Scaleform HUD prompts into 3D space (compatible with HUD replacers). Modern (Borderless) renders crisp custom ImGui/DirectX prompts with badges, icons, and hold rings.
Choose how Modern action badges appear: Keyboard rounded keycaps ('E'/'R') or PlayStation/Xbox circular buttons (Colored or Monochrome).
FontAwesome uses built-in vector glyphs (standalone). FallUI / FIS + Addons loads FallUI_IconLib.swf, FIS XML tag configs (including Modern Age Icons Addon), and your FallUIIconLibrary.ini color set.
Action Only (Minimal) shows compact verbs ('TAKE', 'OPEN'). Action + Name always shows both verb and item name. Name on World Objects keeps loose items minimal while naming doors/NPCs.

content.text: Show Destination Map Above Load Doors
content.help: On = display the destination cell/worldspace name above transition doors (e.g. 'COMMONWEALTH') even when Modern Text Mode is Action Only.
On = show the furniture, terminal, or activator name above Action Only prompts (e.g. CHAIR, SLEEPING BAG, BUTTON).
On = strip visible [Scrap] and {{Aluminum}} item sorter tags from prompts, QuickContainer lists, and the Info Card header while still using them to detect FallUI icons.
Master switch for displaying a category icon next to the primary action verb on Modern world prompts. Off = hide all prompt icons (QuickLoot icons have their own toggle).
On = tint icons using your FallUIIconLibrary.ini palette (or white for uncolored FallUI icons) or FontAwesome category colors. Off = render all icons monochrome using Category Icon Color.
How simultaneous prompts on companions, workbenches, or water sources are arranged: Stacked Vertical (rows) or Inline Horizontal (side by side).
Spacing in pixels between stacked or inline actions when multiple prompts appear. Increase (e.g. 10 px) for looser spacing; decrease (e.g. 2 px) for compact stacking.
Show category icon on Modern prompts for weapons and explosives (requires Master Toggle).
Show category icon on Modern prompts for armor and clothing (requires Master Toggle).
Show category icon on Modern prompts for chems, stimpaks, food, and drinks (requires Master Toggle).
Show category icon on Modern prompts for ammunition (requires Master Toggle).
Show category icon on Modern prompts for misc items, junk, and mods (requires Master Toggle).
Show category icon on Modern prompts for keys and passcards (requires Master Toggle).
Show category icon on Modern prompts for magazines, notes, and books (requires Master Toggle).
Show category icon on Modern prompts for holotapes (requires Master Toggle).
Show category icon on Modern prompts when aiming at containers or lootable bodies outside QuickLoot.
Show category icon on Modern prompts when aiming at doors.
Show category icon on Modern prompts for chairs, beds, and workbenches.
Show category icon on Modern prompts when aiming at terminals.
Show category icon on Modern prompts when targeting NPCs or companions.
Master scale multiplier for all Modern prompt elements together. Increase (e.g. 1.25) for larger text and badges on 1440p/4K; decrease (e.g. 0.75) for smaller, sleeker prompts.
Independent size multiplier for keycaps and controller button badges. Increase to make the button icon larger without scaling text; decrease to keep it compact.
Relative font size of the key character inside the button badge (e.g. 'E'). Increase (e.g. 0.95) for larger letters inside the keycap; decrease (e.g. 0.65) for more inner margin.
Independent text size multiplier for verbs ('TAKE', 'OPEN') and target names. Increase for better legibility; decrease for minimalist prompts.
Independent size multiplier for the category icon next to the action. Increase for bolder icons; decrease for smaller ones.
Horizontal 2D screen-space pixel offset after 3D projection. Positive (+X, e.g. +16) shifts prompts right; negative (-X) shifts left.
Vertical 2D screen-space pixel offset after 3D projection. Positive (+Y) pushes prompts lower on screen; negative (-Y) pushes them higher.
Master alpha opacity of Modern prompt elements. Increase to 1.00 for full brightness; decrease (e.g. 0.50) for a more transparent HUD.

content.text: Modern Box & Layout (Colors adjustable via F1 Menu)

content.help: Backdrop box opacity behind Modern prompts. Default 0.00 keeps them clean and borderless over the world; increase (e.g. 0.65) to show a dark pill box behind text.
On = draw a subtle 1px outline around Modern prompt pills.
On = draw a crisp dark shadow behind Modern text and icons so borderless prompts stay readable over bright skies or lights.
Corner radius in pixels for prompt boxes and keyboard keycaps. Set 0 for sharp square corners; increase (e.g. 8-12 px) for pill-shaped rounded edges.
Left/right inner padding inside Modern prompt pills. Increase for a wider backdrop pill; decrease for a tighter fit.
Top/bottom inner padding inside Modern prompt pills. Increase for a taller pill; decrease for a slimmer prompt.
Horizontal gap in pixels between button badge, category icon, and text. Increase to spread elements out; decrease to pack them tighter.
On = tint Steal, Pickpocket, Trespass text and stealing QuickLoot headers/buttons with the configured crime color (configured in F1 Menu).
On = attach a compact 1-line summary (scrap or Value/Weight) directly below the prompt. Keep Off if you prefer item details only inside the Mini Info Card.
Where the built-in smooth Info Card anchors relative to the floating prompt or pinned to a fixed screen corner. Set Off to disable.
Seconds you must keep aiming at a target before the Mini Info Card smoothly fades in. Set 0.0 for instant reveal; increase (e.g. 0.8s) to hide it while sweeping past items.
Horizontal pixel offset applied to the Mini Info Card. Increase (+X) to shift right / add distance on Right-anchored cards; decrease (-X) to shift left.
Vertical pixel offset applied to the Mini Info Card. Increase (+Y) to move lower on screen; decrease (-Y) to move higher.
Overall scale multiplier for the Mini Info Card text, icons, and layout. Increase (e.g. 1.10) for easier reading; decrease (e.g. 0.65) for a compact footprint.
Master opacity of the entire Mini Info Card. Increase to 1.00 for sharp contrast; decrease for a lighter, semi-transparent overlay.

content.text: Card Style & Geometry (Colors via F1 Menu)

content.help: Backdrop opacity behind the Mini Info Card. Increase (e.g. 0.85) for a solid dark card over bright scenes; decrease toward 0.00 for a transparent floating card.
On = draw a subtle 1px border frame around the Mini Info Card.
On = draw a colored accent strip along the top edge of the Mini Info Card.
On = display the item or NPC category icon beside the title in the Mini Info Card header.
Corner radius in pixels for the Mini Info Card. Set 0 for sharp square corners; increase (e.g. 8-12 px) for softer rounded corners.
Inner margin in pixels between the card border and its contents. Increase for more breathing room; decrease for a tighter box.
Vertical gap in pixels between each detail row. Increase for looser line spacing; decrease to keep long scrap lists compact.
On = list crafting materials yielded when salvaging junk, weapons, or armor (e.g. Screws, Adhesive, Aluminum).
On = show Value (caps), Weight (lbs), and Value/Weight ratio for items.
On = display Damage and Ammo for weapons, and Armor Rating for armor.
On = show equipped weapon, HP, AP, DR, and ER when targeting NPCs.

content.text: Show Mini Info Card inside Modern QuickLoot
content.help: On = display item details (Scrap, Damage, Armor, Weight, Value, Condition) for the currently highlighted row inside Modern QuickLoot.
Choose how item durability/spoilage is shown inside the Mini Info Card for Power Armor pieces and Native Equipment Condition (NEC) gear/food.
On = anchor container, corpse, companion, and workbench quick-loot panels directly over the object in 3D space. Off = keep fixed screen placement.

content.text: Use Modern Style for QuickContainer & Workbenches
content.help: On (when Prompt Style is Modern) = replace the native QuickContainer & Workbench panel with the Modern Borderless UI (with icons, NEC condition bars, sorting, and Hold rings). Off = use native HUD panel.
Smoothing factor per frame for floating QuickLoot panels. Increase (e.g. 0.60) for snappier tracking; decrease (e.g. 0.15) for smoother drifting.
Minimum pixel movement required before shifting the QuickLoot box. Increase (e.g. 8-12 px) to stop small camera jitter while scrolling items; set 0 for zero lag.
World-space East (+X) / West (-X) 3D offset for floating QuickLoot panels (usually keep at 0).
World-space North (+Y) / South (-Y) 3D offset for floating QuickLoot panels (usually keep at 0).
Vertical world-space Z offset for floating QuickLoot panels. Increase (e.g. +20) to float higher above containers/corpses; decrease toward 0 to center over the container.

content.text: Modern QuickLoot Window & Text Sizes (Fonts via F1 Menu)

content.help: Overall scale multiplier for the Modern QuickLoot window. Increase (e.g. 1.20) for larger rows and badges; decrease (e.g. 0.80) for a smaller window.
Lock window content width in pixels so long item names never resize the box while scrolling. Increase (e.g. 340 px) for long modded names; set 0 to auto-fit to text.
On = allow Modern QuickLoot to display up to Max Visible Rows (3-12) at once. Off = cap visible rows at 5 (custom sorting still applies when Sort Mode is not Vanilla).
Number of visible loot rows inside Modern QuickLoot (requires Expand List Beyond 5 Items). Increase (e.g. 8-10) to see more loot at once; decrease (e.g. 4-5) for a compact list.
Extra vertical padding inside each item row. Increase (e.g. 6 px) for taller rows; decrease for tighter, more compact spacing.
Independent font scale multiplier for the container/corpse title. Increase for a bolder title; decrease for a subtler header.
Independent font scale multiplier for loot item names and stack counts. Increase for easier reading; decrease to fit longer names.
Size multiplier for button badges inside QuickLoot and Workbenches. Increase for larger key icons; decrease for smaller ones.
Relative font size of key letters inside QuickLoot button badges (e.g. 'E', 'R'). Increase for bolder inner glyphs; decrease for wider badge padding.
Font scale multiplier for button action labels ('TAKE', 'TRANSFER', 'CRAFT'). Increase for larger footer text; decrease for compact buttons.
On = display FallUI or FontAwesome category icons next to each loot item inside Modern QuickLoot. Off = show text-only item rows.
Choose how item durability/spoilage is shown inside QuickLoot rows for Power Armor pieces and Native Equipment Condition (NEC) weapons, armor, and food.

content.text: QuickLoot Sorting & Priority (Drag & Drop Category Order in F1 Menu)

content.help: Primary sort rule for Modern QuickLoot (Loot, Turrets, Companions, Power Armor). Vanilla mirrors default engine order; Category Priority uses your custom order editable in the F1 Menu.
Tie-breaker sort order applied to items within each category when Sort Mode is set to Category Priority.
On = always keep quest-essential items pinned at the very top of QuickLoot regardless of category.
On = keep Legendary weapons and armor pinned near the top above regular items (right below Quest items).

content.text: Pin Tagged for Search at Top
content.help: On = keep junk items containing components tagged for search (magnifying glass) pinned near the top.
On = keep Bottlecaps pinned near the top above regular loot.
Minimum quiet time (ms) after releasing E before another QuickLoot Take can fire. Increase (e.g. 60-120 ms) if key chatter double-takes items; set 0 for maximum rapid-loot speed.
